topic: Memory Grove hover feedback and real prerequisite progression
currentUserGoal: Continue the redesign with another update slice after the first Memory Grove layout polish.
workCompleted: Connected Memory Grove hover enter and leave through the accessible DOM bridge so invisible agent controls no longer prevent Phaser hover feedback.
Added a dedicated animated hover ring, stronger hovered-node bob and pulse, gentler persistent selection motion, and a more active zoomed detail icon while hovering.
Moved the Memory Grove prerequisite graph into RunSpineSystem as the source of truth and made connector rendering read the same graph.
Added prerequisite purchase enforcement: Soft Touch unlocks Deeper Roots and Tiny Sprinkler, Deeper Roots unlocks Scourge Sense, and Tiny Sprinkler plus Scourge Sense unlock Last Stand.
Added locked-path labels and detail-card explanations naming the missing memories, plus Sensi feedback for blocked purchases.
Updated accessible memory buttons to expose unlocked, affordable, owned, and path-locked states.
Fixed the Memory Grove Available GT header so it refreshes immediately after a purchase instead of showing stale currency.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 31 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
Browser playtest on ?redesign&playtest&resetMemory confirmed only Soft Touch starts affordable with 80 GT.
Forced a Deeper Roots purchase while locked and confirmed it spent 0 GT, bought no memory, and showed Remember Soft Touch first in the detail card.
Bought Soft Touch and confirmed GT changed from 80 to 68, both Deeper Roots and Tiny Sprinkler became affordable, and the canvas Available GT header also changed to 68.
Visually confirmed the animated ring and zoomed detail treatment on the selected and hovered memory node.
currentGitStatus: Expected after this handoff commit: clean worktree on codex/gameplay-update, two commits ahead of origin/codex/gameplay-update.
knownIssues: The Memory Grove still contains only five memories and will need more content and stronger environmental charm before it feels like the old full skill tree.
Legacy redesign saves with out-of-order owned memories remain accepted so existing test saves are not destructively stripped.
The user has not yet manually playtested the full prerequisite sequence with their own mouse and normal run-earned GT.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user play one normal run through dormancy and test the Memory Grove progression without playtest grants.
Next content slice: expand the Memory Grove with a second tier of small, mechanically distinct memories while preserving the non-crossing two-lane layout.
After content exists, add purchase and branch-reveal flourish using the existing skill assets and SFX rather than adding more static panels.
doNotRevert: Keep the improved Scourge pacing and run balance from the previous slices.
Keep the accessible DOM controls; hover feedback must continue to work through them.
Keep the prerequisite graph in RunSpineSystem and derive visual connectors from it so rules and presentation stay synchronized.
Do not restore crossing connector routes or the stale Available GT behavior.
